test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - GA (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: In Census of India 2011, what is the criteria regarding the density of population for considering a settlement as a Census town?
solution:
The correct answer is __**400 persons per sq. km.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Population density at a **minimum of 400 persons per square kilometre.**
 
• The population density of India according to the 2011 Census was** 382 persons per square kilometre.**
 
• The **global **average for population density was roughly **15 people per sq. km.**
 
• The state with the** short population density is Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• **Bihar** is the most massively populated state **(1106 persons/sq km.)** followed by west Bengal-1028 and Kerala 860, as per **Census of India 2011.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Census has been organized in** India since 1872 and 2011** marks the first time **biometric data** was collected.
 
• The **15th Census** of India was organized in **2011.**
 
• Population census provides the government an outlook of the distinct population in distinct parts of the country which will in turn support the government in the sufficient provision of social services like** housing, water, electricity, roads, schools, and hospital which is beneficial to the citizens of the country.**
